name: Custom loop
note: A while loop and a switch
summary: Writing the agent loop yourself directly against a model API instead of adopting a framework. The program sends messages and tool definitions, executes any tool calls the model returns, appends the results and repeats until the model stops calling tools. It keeps every prompt and response visible at the cost of building persistence, retries and approvals yourself.
facts: Full control, but no built-in durability, memory or sandboxing
watchOut: Crash recovery and resumption are on you
Context management grows complex over long runs
how: Send the conversation and tool schemas to the model API
If the response contains tool calls, dispatch each one in a switch
Append the tool results to the conversation
Repeat until the model returns a final answer or a step limit is hit
